verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own manual CSV export of candidate data from Settings → Data Export, plus built-in analytics charts that can be saved as PNG or shared. This is a one-off export rather than a recurring schedule, and the documented API covers candidates and jobs, not reporting. Missing for 10: custom report builder, scheduled/recurring exports, BI or warehouse connectors, documented reporting/analytics API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can build custom reports and get the data OUT — scheduled exports, BI connectors, or a documented reporting API to my warehouse

citations.quote: Export your candidate data to a CSV from **Settings → Data Export**.
Click the three dots on any chart to **Save as PNG**, open a **Full screen view**, or **Share** the chart.
